tools.name: check_website
tools.description: Checks a public small-business website with Sitecomb's website check. It returns a score out of 100 and the areas that have problems, with a count for each. It does not name the problems: those are in the full report. Use it when someone asks whether their website is any good, or what is wrong with

tools.name: explain_area
tools.description: Explains what Sitecomb looks at in one of its six areas: security, privacy, quality, phones, customers or ai. Use it when someone asks what Sitecomb checks, or about an area named in a check_website result. It doesn't check any website.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "check_website" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
